title: Memory is spent for security, speed and simplicity
scope: project-wide; constrains every later design decision rather than one subsystem

summary.headline: Memory is what we spend to buy safety, speed and simplicity
summary.body:
When a design has to give something up, memory goes first. Novis is not built to run in the
smallest possible footprint, and "this allocates less" is never on its own a reason to change
anything. The limit is that memory spent must belong to a request, stay under a ceiling the
operator sets, and be released when that request ends. Growth that tracks total traffic served
is a leak, not a trade.
